fit_method.acceptance: for every kind, calibrated validation NLL <= uncalibrated validation NLL
fit_method.objective: mean negative log-likelihood of the correct candidate on the fitting partition
fit_method.selection: fitting partition only; validation is used to accept or reject the result
fit_method.transform: softmax((logits - alpha * blank_prompt_logits) / temperature); blank-prompt logits per kind and candidate count

inference.choice: nearest_2shot, order A (second-nearest, nearest, query); production zero-shot fallback
inference.logits: uncalibrated candidate logits of the production candidate scoring
inference.score: zero_shot (S1): the LLM path the score parameters apply to; kNN-5 votes are not calibrated

boundary: temperature at the upper search bound 100.000000
prior alpha at the upper bound 2.000000

guarantees: calibration queries are training-split rows (the exemplar allowlist); validation, test and external rows are not used
every row of a query's group_id is held out of the retrieval pool, so no query sees itself or a variant of its group as a demonstration
a group_id belongs wholly to the fitting or the validation partition
exemplars whose content equals the query's are never demonstrations (the production content-key rule)
the database records no scenario-family metadata beyond group_id; groups.source is the source dataset, which is not used as a partition unit

warnings: score: boundary solution: temperature at the upper search bound 100.000000
score: boundary solution: prior alpha at the upper bound 2.000000
